name: Total processing card payments for WooCommerce
author: totalprocessing

sections.description:
Take Payments via Total Processing’s Payment Gateway.
Accept Payments with the aid of 300 acquiring connectors based globally via our Gateway infrastructure.
Access extended oversight and transaction monitoring via the Total Processing plug-in for WooCommerce with our bespoke, data rich merchant services and people-centric support resources.

‘Pioneering Payments’

PAYMENT METHODS

Credit/Debit cards:

  • VISA
  • MasterCard
  • American Express

FEATURES

  • All Major Credit/Cebit Card brands accredited with the PCI DSS standard.
  • Tokenisation and ‘Remember Me’ options at the check-out.
  • One-click Payments.
  • iFrame for PCI DSS Compliance.
  • Payment in Modal popup (can turn on/off from settings)
  • Tech and Customer Support for Full and Partial Payment Refunds.
  • 24/7 Support from Teams based in the UK.
  • Worldwide Support from our Connectors and Partners.
  • Support for all Currencies and Alternative Payment Methods across 196 Countries.
sections.installation:
1. Install the Plug-in via Plug-ins -> New Plug-in (Search for ‘Totalprocessing_Card_Payments_And_Gateway_Woocommerce’).
  2. You Will be redirected to setup wizard.
  3. Enter your Credentials as provided by Total Processing (Default Entity ID and Access token) and configure any settings needed.
  4. If you are using Test Credentials use the ‘Test’ endpoint, otherwise, if you have a live MID with us, use the ‘Live’ endpoint.

How can I report security bugs?

You can report security bugs through the Patchstack Vulnerability Disclosure Program. The Patchstack team help validate, triage and handle any security vulnerabilities. Report a security vulnerability.
sections.changelog:
7.3

Major Update – October 21, 2025

New

  • Transaction Log: A dedicated payment gateway log has been added to the WooCommerce order details page, providing administrators with detailed transaction information for easier debugging and support.

Improved

  • Refund Processing: The integration for processing refunds directly from WooCommerce has been improved. This ensures more accurate and reliable communication with the payment gateway when a refund is initiated.
  • Transaction Verification: The payment processing logic has been enhanced to more gracefully handle pending verification states. This significantly reduces instances of ‘Uncertain Response’ statuses and improves reliability.
  • Apple Pay Integration: The plugin has been updated to align with Apple’s latest payment processing requirements.

Fixed

  • Apple Pay Transaction ID: The transaction ID for Apple Pay payments now correctly uses the standard WooCommerce Order ID. This reverts a recent change that used a proprietary ID (e.g., NP_…), ensuring consistency and simplifying order reconciliation.

Removed

  • Apple Pay Temporary Email: In compliance with new requirements from Apple that enforce email validation, the functionality for Apple’s temporary “Private Relay” emails has been removed.

7.2.2

Enhanced Apple Pay Checkout Control

  • Introduced a new setting to enable or disable the Terms & Conditions checkbox validation for Apple Pay transactions.
  • Added a dedicated settings field to customize the pop-up error message displayed when a user attempts payment without accepting the Terms & Conditions

7.2.1

ApplePay Security Improvements

  • Added strict field validation on WooCommerce checkout.
  • Prevents payment processing until all required fields (e.g., phone number, team) are validated.

Fixes

  • Resolved field bypass vulnerability where payment could be initiated without checkout validation.
  • Removed automatic order cancellations for incomplete/invalid transactions.

Technical Details

  • Updated validation in tp-gateway-loader.js (Form Validation Layer).
  • Updated class-wc-tp-applepay-gateway.php in onPaymentAuthorized() (Order Processing Pipeline).
  • Removed redundant Apple Pay loading.
  • Removed unneccessary code blocks

7.2.0

  • Improved Apple Pay Stability: Refactored code to resolve multiple bugs and ensure a smoother checkout experience. Issues resolved include duplicate and empty order creation, incorrect pricing due to discounts, and problems with automated upsells.
  • Lottery Plugin Compatibility: Ensured Apple Pay compatibility with lottery plugins, allowing correct ticket generation.
  • TeraWallet Integration: Resolved final amount bugs by improving Apple Pay compatibility with TeraWallet.
  • Saved Card Token Removal via UI: Added the ability to manually remove a customer’s saved cards directly from WordPress settings.

7.1.8

  • Minor update to add Patchstack Vulnerability Disclosure Program information to WordPress listing

7.1.7

Terawallet Partial Payment Support for Apple Pay

  • Added compatibility with Apple Pay for Terawallet partial payments services.

Enhanced Security

  • Strengthened overall plugin security with improved validation, sanitization, and secure coding practices across the plugin.

Patchstack VDP Integration

  • Integrated with Patchstack’s Vulnerability Disclosure Program (VDP).

Tested with Latest WordPress & Woocommerce

  • Tested up to Core 6.8 and Woo 9.8.

7.1.6 – Security Patch Release

  • Fixed a security vulnerability present since v7.1.3.
  • Applied enhanced security measures to improve overall stability.
  • Fixed Apple Pay compatibility with WooCommerce ‘Pay for Order’ alternate checkout flow.
